sourceRefs.locator: File description, original 1,223 × 1,750 reproduction, file history dated 17 April 2012, and licensing as a public-domain scan.
The Newberry identifies Ayer MS 1515, attributes transcription and translation to Francisco Ximénez and describes the two columns of the surviving K’iche’ manuscript.

labels.de: Die erste Textseite des Popol Wuj
labels.en: The opening text page of the Popol Wuj

alt.de: Zwei dicht beschriebene Spalten auf einem vergilbten Blatt. Die ersten Worte sind größer. Links beginnt der Text auf K’iche’, rechts die spanische Übersetzung. Am linken Rand stehen die Ziffern 1, 2 und 3.
alt.en: Two dense columns of handwriting on a yellowed leaf. The opening words are larger. K’iche’ begins on the left and the Spanish translation on the right. The figures 1, 2 and 3 appear down the left margin.

creators: K’iche’ tellers and writers of the Popol Wuj
rights.attribution: Popol Wuj, Newberry Library, Chicago, Ayer MS 1515. K’iche’ narrative with transcription and Spanish translation by Francisco Ximénez. Public-domain facsimile via Wikimedia Commons.
rights.originNote: Unmodified full-resolution reproduction of the opening text page (1,223 × 1,750 pixels). The Commons file identifies the mechanical scan and original manuscript as public domain, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/.
